name: Honda of South Carolina Mfg. (ATV/UTV Plant) - Timmonsville SC

fieldNotes.truckGate: Confirmed in Street View and z20 satellite: a controlled entrance on the access road (Honda Way) with a guard booth straddling the entry, traffic cones marking multiple lanes, and an island. Clear controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Confirmed - Street View (2019 capture) shows a uniformed guard standing at the gate beside a small multi-window guard booth. High confidence.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: false - a staffed guard booth is present.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Internal paved aprons between the gate and the dock/trailer areas provide deep queuing room (drivewayLong = true).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The gate has multiple marked lanes and paved apron width allowing an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Extensive dock lines with trailers backed in along multiple building wings (east face and interior wings); ~55 doors estimated - 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large trailer drop yards southwest of the plant with hundreds of trailers in organized rows (multiple carrier colors); well into the 50+ band.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock banks appear on physically separate building faces / wings - shipping and receiving run from distinct clusters.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur runs into the property.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - plant is in farmland/woodland near Timmonsville, Florence County, SC, beside I-95; small-town industrial setting, not dense metro.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus has multiple connected and adjacent large building wings plus an ATV proving/test track to the northwest - multiple building clusters.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~230 acres derived from the perimeter box (excludes the separate test-track land); approximate.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale identified in imagery; flagged uncertain.
